title: E2E coverage for full SBOM workflow
observed_context: Artifact detail page renders SBOMDetails only after switching to the SBOM tab.
Policy create flow defaults to the visual PolicyRuleBuilder and can sync visual rules to the JSON editor.
Events page provides an SBOM filter category for canonical SBOM attestation/index events.
intended_behavior: Users can view SBOM attestations on artifact pages, build SBOM policy rules visually, and filter live events to SBOM-specific activity.
scope: Playwright E2E tests plus canonical SBOM event subscription coverage for the events read model.
